categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three business segments: Personal & Household, Enterprise Customers, and International Customers. It provides mobile communication, fixed-line communication, broadband access, internet services, and ICT integration services including data centers, cloud, cybersecurity, IoT, and emerging technologies. The company also has technical divisions focusing on network technology, information technology, and telecommunications research.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include 5G mobile networks, fiber-optic broadband (FTTH/FTTB), cloud computing, AI, big data analytics, IoT platforms, blockchain, AR/VR, and cybersecurity solutions. The company employs software-defined networking (SDN), network function virtualization (NFV), and open radio access network (O-RAN) architectures. It also develops satellite communications and innovative energy-saving technologies for network infrastructure.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include individual consumers and households, domestic and international enterprises, and government agencies. The company serves markets in Taiwan and abroad, providing integrated telecom and ICT solutions tailored to vertical industries such as manufacturing, finance, healthcare, transportation, and smart cities. It also targets international clients with cross-border telecom and cloud services.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with extensive nationwide coverage including remote areas. It has international presence through subsidiaries and partnerships in the Asia-Pacific region including the United States, Japan, Vietnam, Singapore, Thailand, and Indonesia. It invests in international submarine cable infrastructure to support global connectivity.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream telecom service provider, managing network infrastructure, service delivery, and customer-facing operations. It also engages in upstream activities such as network equipment procurement and technology development through its research institute and subsidiaries. It maintains a sustainable supply chain with ESG-compliant suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities focus on sustainable development, 5G network expansion, and innovative digital transformation. R&D initiatives emphasize 5G and beyond technologies, AI, IoT, cloud computing, cybersecurity, AR/VR, blockchain, and ESG energy-saving solutions. The company aims to lead in smart living and digital economy enablement, fostering ecosystem partnerships and talent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales and service subscriptions including mobile and fixed-line communication plans, broadband access fees, value-added digital content (e.g., MOD, Hami Video), enterprise ICT solutions, cloud and data center services, and international telecom services. The company also issues sustainable development bonds to finance green projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is the largest integrated telecom operator in Taiwan, holding leading market shares in mobile subscribers, broadband access, and IPTV services. It faces competition from other domestic telecom operators and cable TV providers, especially amid industry consolidation. The company maintains a competitive edge through superior network quality, extensive coverage, innovative services, and strong brand reputation.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$216.7 billion in the latest fiscal year, with net profit attributable to owners of NT$36.5 billion and earnings per share of NT$4.70. It has shown steady revenue and profit growth, supported by robust cash flow and a strong balance sheet. Capital expenditures focus on 5G network buildout and data center expansion. The company maintains a high credit rating (AA) and a 100% cash dividend payout ratio.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes customer-centric service with the fastest and most reliable 5G network coverage in Taiwan, integrated multi-network solutions (mobile, fixed, Wi-Fi), and a leading digital content platform. It differentiates through innovative ICT solutions for enterprises, comprehensive smart living services, and strong ESG commitments including renewable energy usage and carbon reduction. Its extensive ecosystem partnerships and advanced R&D capabilities further enhance its competitive advantage.
